name: Rifa'a al-Tahtawi in Paris
traveler: Rifa'a al-Tahtawi, imam of the Egyptian student mission
summary: Muhammad Ali sends forty-four young Egyptians to study in France, with a young Azhar scholar as their imam. Tahtawi learns French, reads Montesquieu and Rousseau, watches the July Revolution of 1830, and comes home to write the first Arabic description of a modern European country.

stops.note: The student mission leaves the capital.
They board the French ship La Truite.
Quarantine, then his first sight of a French city.
Five years of study. He describes the city's streets, newspapers, theatres and the charter that limits the king.
He watches the July Revolution drive out Charles X.
South to take ship for home.
Home, to found a school of translation.
